Now I'll present the findings and plan in the required output format.

## 🚨 Biggest Issue
Lumina pivoted from a product called **InboxZap** (email cleanup/inbox-zero) but the rebrand is only half-done. All 12 published blog posts are still InboxZap content (Gmail storage, inbox zero, bulk-delete emails), and they're the only thing getting real organic traffic — `gsc/Pages.csv` shows them pulling 80–3,900 impressions each, while every post ranks on page 5+ (positions 42–58) for queries totally unrelated to meeting transcription. That traffic is currently being wasted.

👉 **301-redirect all 12 legacy posts into `/blog`** to preserve the equity instead of losing it, per the migration plan I generated from your GSC export (`.seoagent/strategy/migration-plan.md`):

```
/blog/post-1   -> /blog
/blog/post-2   -> /blog
/blog/post-3   -> /blog
/blog/post-4   -> /blog
/blog/post-5   -> /blog
/blog/post-6   -> /blog
/blog/post-7   -> /blog
/blog/post-8   -> /blog
/blog/post-9   -> /blog
/blog/post-10  -> /blog
/blog/post-11  -> /blog
/blog/post-12  -> /blog
```

**One override on the tool's auto-plan:** it also flagged your homepage (`/`) as "off-topic — redirect," which is wrong — it's your actual homepage, converting fine (18 clicks, position 4.5, your best-performing page). I excluded it. Want me to add the 12 redirects above to `next.config.js`?

## ⚠️ Also Worth Fixing
- **`/blog` is invisible to search engines.** The live page is a client-side shell (3 words of server HTML) that fetches `/api/posts` — which 404s. No new blog content can be indexed until this is fixed; it blocks writing any new articles.
- **I already fixed** stale InboxZap metadata in `app/layout.tsx` (title/description/OG) — the deployed homepage had the right Lumina copy, but this repo's source would have regressed it on the next deploy.
- `/pricing` is missing a canonical tag and all JSON-LD, and `/features` has a duplicate `<h1>` ("Integrations" mid-page) — both confirmed live, but neither page has a corresponding file in this repo, so I can't patch them directly; flagged in `audit/latest.md` for whoever owns that source.

## ✅ What's Working
- Homepage already has solid `Organization`/`SoftwareApplication` JSON-LD, full OG/Twitter tags, and a clean canonical.
- robots.txt has no accidental blocks, and every page passes on meta descriptions.
- Your product positioning (Features/Pricing pages) is clear and specific — good raw material for new content.
- One finding ("`/pricing` missing from sitemap") turned out to be a tool false-positive — I re-checked the live sitemap.xml directly and `/pricing` is there.

I also drafted a forward content plan: one pillar cluster ("AI Meeting Assistant" — 1 pillar + 4 sub-pillars + 8 long-tails) plus a comparison sub-cluster (Lumina vs. Fireflies/Otter), in `.seoagent/roadmap.md` and `strategy/clusters/ai-meeting-assistant.md`.

## What do you want to do?
1. Apply the 12-redirect `next.config.js` change above (shown for approval, not yet written)
2. Approve the content roadmap so I start writing the pillar article + cluster
3. Investigate why `/pricing`, `/features`, and the blog posts are live but have no source files in this repo (likely a different deploy branch) — that's blocking several fixes
4. Something else
